name: Full Crew
overview: Full cast and crew by department, break bumpers, and library stats
description: Fetches complete TMDB cast and crew for movies and series, groups people by department, and shows them in a polished accordion on Jellyfin Web item detail pages. Includes a nostalgia Break Bumper action and a Library Stats page (genres, people, collections, resolution/HDR/codecs, and more).

versions.changelog: Initial release: full TMDB cast/crew accordion, JS Injector + File Transformation injection, shared Jellyfin TMDB key fallback.
